lines.text: Paul tells the believers to be strong in the Lord's mighty power and put on God's full armor to stand against the devil's schemes.
Paul says their struggle is against flesh and blood, so they should take up the armor to stand on the day of evil.

wrong_details.wrong: Their struggle is against flesh and blood
wrong_details.true: Their struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against spiritual forces of evil

lines.text: They are to wear the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit.
Paul asks them to pray at all times for all the saints, and for him to speak boldly as an ambassador in chains.
Paul sends Tychicus to encourage them, and he closes with peace and love from Peter and the church in Jerusalem.

wrong_details.wrong: peace and love from Peter and the church in Jerusalem
wrong_details.true: peace and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
